description: Step 2 of preparing a launch: with the message from bootr_launch_message and the user’s wallet signature of it, returns the unsigned transactions (approve, launch, gas) for that wallet to send. The server pins the image and stores the agent’s text; nothing goes on-chain and no funds move. Defaults move money: leaving out fuelUsdc still means 20 USDC, leaving out gasEth 0.001 ETH. launchThrough clanker is the site’s Clanker path, Clanker v5 on bootr.fun (the answer’s launchThrough says which). On Clanker v5, launch.token sets the coin for good: pairedAsset (ETH, the default, or USDC: what it trades against and what every fee is paid in), buyTaxPct and sellTaxPct (1 to 5, default 1.5), burnPct and dividendsPct (percent of the tax pool, together at most 65), minDividendHolding, rewards (who gets the creator’s share: up to 5 rows of recipient, admin and pct adding up to 100, the user’s wallet first), sniperTax and editableMetadata (both default true). Every field is optional. Ask the user for each choice rather than picking one; out-of-bounds settings are refused before anything is sent, so the signature can be used again.

launch.description: The launch fields: GET /api/catalog lists them.

message.description: The text from bootr_launch_message, exactly as signed.

signature.description: The wallet’s signature of message, as 0x hex. Never a private key.
